storage_policy: Every run, every offered case, all 25 aggregated operation vectors and resource counters saved in compressed partitioned Parquet. Detailed per-visit traces for prespecified stratified reproducible sample, ALL errors/violations and extreme cases; exact deterministic replay by input, parameters, code, keyed RNG. A full 3.16-billion-row visit ledger is optional and expensive.
write_policy: write after every completed batch, atomic file rename, manifest & SHA256 checksums, resume uses only validated completed partitions
metric_invariants: T72_ms is bounded [0,259200000]; open cases never silently dropped
for each case operation worker and equipment milliseconds nonnegative; manual allocations reconcile with resource ledger
no false closure, no repeated inventory receipt, no quality bypass, no illegal address
business-case full wall time is NOT sum of simultaneous service visits
block time on critical path and external time reconciles with case wall duration for completed cases
minimum_granularity: EVERY_RUN × EVERY_OFFERED_CASE × ALL_25_OPERATIONS; include zeros with NOT_APPLICABLE reason
fidelity: Every case preserves 25 operation summary vectors; exact visit/event sequence reconstructable on demand by frozen code, input manifests, keyed RNG, with verification of checksum of recomputed case ledger. If replay fails, block MAIN and fix replay or persist full visits.
partitions: scenario/load/config/seed with atomic tmp->rename, no lossy averaging of individual cases; separate Parquet physical + simulation wall timing.
new_audit: 100% case ledger counts reconcile to offered manifest and run summary
every operated resource allocation reconciles human labor including drivers
P10 and P18 require driver and forklift both allocated throughout driving
for every pair C000/Cxxx original offered case_id list and external event hashes identical per S/L/seed
replay 10 prespecified cases incl C000/C127 plus worst S4/S6 exactly matches case-level 25 operation vectors
no ML training leakage; root model hashes locked per train/test split
